mapper.select: select id, username, password_hash, nickname, email, status, created_at, updated_at from app_user where username = #{username} limit 1
select id, username, password_hash, nickname, email, status, created_at, updated_at from app_user where email = #{email} limit 1

select d.id as department_id, d.name as department_name, cm.joined_at from club_member cm inner join department d on d.id = cm.department_id where cm.user_id = #{userId} and cm.status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1
